findings.detail: `CHANGELOG.md` still publishes REQ-2026-082 phase-1/2 as completed work—including landing/onboarding changes and `npx commitgate --help` coverage for `setup` plus a dispatch/help test—while this staged change contains only the changelog and Quick Start cost notices. On the normal release path, a user relying on this release note will follow the claimed updated landing/help; those required onboarding/help fixes are absent from the committed change, so the release documentation makes a false completion claim and the documented setup path remains unfixed. Add the corresponding landing/README, CLI help, and test changes to the staged commit, or remove/defer the completion claims until they are actually included.

next_action: Stage the implementation and verification artifacts claimed by the REQ-2026-082 changelog entries (or revise the changelog to describe only this Quick Start documentation change), then request phase review again.
